name: gitpro
description: Per-repo git identities (name, email, SSH key, signing) with the gitpro CLI: a skill, a PreToolUse hook that stops Claude committing or pushing as the wrong identity, and a read-only MCP server. The hook and the server need gitpro on the plain sh PATH (pipx install git+https://github.com/sandeepshelke/gitpro.git); without it the hook does nothing.
